name: Volcano
description: Deploy functions, durable workflows, Postgres databases, sandboxes and frontends for agents and apps from one CLI and REST API, with a per-project MCP server, for developers.

skills.name: Deploy Functions
skills.description: Deploys Node.js, Python or Ruby functions that run over HTTP or on a cron schedule, and lists their deployments.

skills.name: Run Durable Workflows
skills.description: Runs durable functions that save each step and resume after waits, retries or human approval, and sends them messages.

skills.name: Provision Postgres
skills.description: Provisions managed PostgreSQL databases with row-level security, branches and backups, with email, OAuth or anonymous sign-in.

skills.name: Run Sandboxes
skills.description: Runs untrusted commands in isolated sandbox sessions, reading and writing session files and suspending or ending sessions.

skills.name: Search Logs
skills.description: Searches a project's logs and lists runtime errors and failed builds so an agent can debug a deployment.
